items.exampleEn: Too little sleep can impair your memory.
items.exampleZh: 睡眠太少會損害記憶力。

items.exampleEn: He intentionally left the door open for the cat.
items.exampleZh: 他故意把門開著讓貓進來。

items.exampleEn: The students repaid their teacher's hard work with good grades.
items.exampleZh: 學生們用好成績回報老師的辛勞。

items.exampleEn: There are hanging lights above the table.
She tried not to limp in front of her friends.
items.exampleZh: 她努力不在朋友面前一瘸一拐地走。

items.exampleEn: Window cleaners wear a harness when they work on tall buildings.
items.exampleZh: 擦窗工人在高樓工作時會穿戴安全吊帶。

items.exampleEn: The runaway came home after two days.
items.exampleZh: 那個離家出走的人兩天後回家了。

items.sentenceEn: Thank you! I'll repay you one day.
items.sentenceZh: 謝謝你！總有一天我會報答你。

items.audioEn: After the long walk, my dog was limping, so I carried him home.
items.audioZh: 長時間散步後，我的狗走路一瘸一拐的，所以我把牠抱回家。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼把狗抱回家？
options: It started to rain very hard.

items.sentenceEn: The horse was wearing a red harness.
items.sentenceZh: 那匹馬戴著紅色的挽具。

items.stemEn: I borrowed fifty dollars from my brother, and I'll ____ him on Friday.
items.stemZh: 我向弟弟借了五十元，星期五會還他。

items.stemEn: The police found the young ____ hiding at the bus station.
items.stemZh: 警方發現那個離家出走的少年躲在公車站。

items.passageEn: Last Saturday, I went rock climbing for the first time. Before we started, the teacher checked everyone's harness. A boy named Sam joked that he would fall intentionally to scare us, but the teacher didn't laugh. In the middle of the climb, fog came in and impaired our view, so we climbed down. My heart was thumping, and I shivered in the cold fog. Sam hurt his ankle and limped back to the bus, so I carried his bag for him. On the way home, the teacher told us a story about a young runaway who lived in the mountains. Sam said I helped him a lot that day, and he promised to repay me with ice cream. Now our photo is next to my hanging plants.
items.passageZh: 上週六，我第一次去爬山壁。開始前，老師檢查了每個人的安全吊帶。一個叫 Sam 的男生開玩笑說他會故意摔下去嚇我們，但老師沒有笑。爬到一半時，霧飄了過來，阻礙了我們的視線，所以我們爬了下來。我的心臟砰砰直跳，在冷霧中直發抖。Sam 傷到了腳踝，一瘸一拐地走回巴士，所以我幫他拿包包。回家路上，老師跟我們說了一個關於住在山裡的離家出走少年的故事。Sam 說我那天幫了他很多，答應會請我吃冰淇淋來報答我。現在，我們的合照就放在我的吊掛盆栽旁邊。

questions.questionZh: 為什麼他們爬到一半就下來了？
Sam 答應怎麼報答作者？
options: 幫作者寫一個星期的作業
送作者一條新的安全吊帶

rubricZh: intentionally 表示「故意地」，例如 do something intentionally 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 repay 造一個句子，說說你想怎麼報答幫助過你的人。
referenceEn: I want to repay my parents for their love.
I will repay my friend by helping her with math.
rubricZh: repay 表示「報答、償還」，例如 repay someone for… 等說法
說的是自己的想法（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（例如說未來的事用 will、be going to，或用 want to 表達想法等）
